methodology_other: Dataset: This COD-AB was developed from various existing Myanmar Information Management Unit (MIMU) "v9.4" HDX datasets, which are understood to be the final versions expected from MIMU. These datasets have been assembled into this COD-AB without correcting existing errors. Known errors are documented in the file titled "MMR COD-AB ITOS Error Documentation.pdf", which is included with this dataset. Administrative Level 5 covers urban areas only and is not represented in the mmr_polbndl_adm01234_250k_mimu_itos_20240215 lines layer.
name: cod-ab-mmr
notes:
Myanmar administrative level 0-5 boundaries (COD-AB) dataset version 01.  
  
This dataset is structured into 5 levels:  
- Admin 1: 18 State/Region  
- Admin 2: 80 District  
- Admin 3: 330 Township  
- Admin 4: 14174 Town / Village tract, partial coverage  
- Admin 5: 1999 , partial coverage  
  
  
Dates associated with this dataset:  
- 30 October 2025: dataset reviewed for accuracy and completeness  
- 15 February 2024: valid for use by the humanitarian community  
- 11 March 2024: last edit to the dataset before publishing  
- 11 March 2024: boundaries created by the source  
  
Quality assured, configured, and published by [OCHA Field Information Services (FIS)](https://data.humdata.org/organization/ocha-fiss) and [HDX](https://data.humdata.org/organization/hdx).  
  
Part of the dataset: [Global Subnational Administrative Boundaries](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/cod-ab-global)
